title: M100 job failure telemetry correlation
query_text: My job 7798450 failed this afternoon. Was it the node's hardware, or did my job itself die? What does the telemetry show?

eval_criteria.gold_answer: Your job 7798450 (qmc_solver) ran on node r2n5 and entered the FAILED state with exit_code 1:0 and reason JobLaunchFailure. The IPMI telemetry shows r2n5 total_power collapsing from its active draw to idle, and CPU package power (p0_power, p1_power) dropping to idle at the same time — consistent with your job process terminating, not a node hardware fault (idle power is normal afterward). Check the job's stderr for the launch failure and resubmit.
